name: scrawl
description: A free, self-hostable multiplayer draw-and-guess party game.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @scrawl/server && npm run build -w @scrawl/client
scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @scrawl/client
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:client && cp client/dist/index.html client/dist/404.html
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @scrawl/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p client
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && VITE_TRANSPORT=http npm run build -w @scrawl/client
